Maya Patel: Heads-up — Acme QBR is next Tue 10am PT. Need a quick sync on slides, what we demo, and the renewal ask (R1).
Samir Khan: Got it — onboarding shows 78% feature activation, still waiting on SSO and data import completion from their side.
Joanna Li: I can take the customer journey slide + demo flow. Will add notes about the SSO blocker and mitigation plan.
Tom Reyes: Renewal risk? last touch said they flagged latency for long prompts — is that still an exec-level risk?
Maya Patel: Risk is medium-high. If SSO and import finish + we show perf plan, we can keep it green. Need an explicit exec ask: 6-month discount + dedicated support slot.
Samir Khan: I'll escalate import ETA — emailed their infra lead this morning, tentative completion EOD Friday.
Joanna Li: Slide owners: journey/demo=Joanna, health/metrics=Samir, exec-ask+risk=Tom, enablement plan=Maya.
Tom Reyes: Can we run a 20-min dry run Fri 11am? want to rehearse the exec ask phrasing.
Maya Patel: Yes — dry run Fri 11am. Tom will lead the ask. Joanna will demo, Samir will field health Qs.
cs-bot: Automated summary: onboarding_status=partial; feature_activation=78%; pending_tasks=[SSO, data_import]; NPS=7.2
Samir Khan: Re: slide deck — uploaded v2 here: https://redwood.sales/files/acme-qbr-deck-v2.pdf
Joanna Li: Small ask: add a one-liner at the top of the demo slide re: fallback plan for latency (cache + quantized model). I'll paste text in the deck.
Tom Reyes: +1 — also add a one-slide appendix with pre-roll mitigation timeline (30/60/90 days).
Maya Patel: Action items: Samir — confirm import ETA (due Thu EOD), Joanna — update deck + add fallback one-liner (Thu noon), Tom — draft exec ask script (Thu EOD), Maya — collect stakeholder list and run dry run invite (Fri AM).
Samir Khan: Noted. Will ping infra if no response by 4pm today.
Joanna Li: I'll do a quick recording of the demo flow after updates so the team can rehearse ahead of Fri.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. If anything slips, we escalate to CSM lead and ask for a short technical touchpoint with infra owners. :thumbsup:
Tom Reyes: Sounds good. See you Fri.
cs-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry_run_acme_qbr Fri 11:00 sent to participants.
